stem: Morphine belongs to which medication class used for hard-to-control pain?

options.label: A
options.text: ACE inhibitors used for blood-pressure control only
options.misconception: Lisinopril class — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong class; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: B
options.text: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors used for lipids only
options.misconception: Statin class — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong class; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: C
options.text: Opiate narcotic analgesics used for hard-to-control pain
options.misconception: None; morphine is an opiate analgesic.

options.label: D
options.text: Loop diuretics used for edema fluid removal only
options.misconception: Furosemide class — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong class; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: E
options.text: Biguanides used for type 2 glucose control only
options.misconception: Metformin class — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong class; see the cited source passage for detail.

context: Learning objective: morphine as opiate analgesic.
